dataset: 50k synthetic series, 120 counter samples each, 60 eval steps, TimeSeries v11
source: system.query_log QueryFinish records from local experiment
method: Client calls SELECT ... FORMAT Null, then SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS; one measurement for each selector, not latency distribution
observations: region=east matches 25k / 50k, but query read_rows is unchanged at 550k. Filtering did not reduce data rows scanned in this plan.
team=t01 matches 1563 series but still reads 373104 rows (~68% of 550k).

host=h0001 matches 1 series but reads 58448 rows. This may be due index granularity, mark scanning, and shared inner table reads; examine individual table profile before attributing all reads to samples.
Three AggregatingTransform nodes in native unpatched PromQL SQL; fast patch intends to remove one due unnecessary metric-name-drop duplicate check.
No disk reads (OSReadBytes=0) in this warm sample; these are not cold cache tests.
